priority_slice.name: Conservative economic admission of optional final-link products
priority_slice.decision: Accept no-GNU-build-ID driver refusal before discovery/full identity; execute unchanged original clang command on refusal.
priority_slice.location: crates/zil-backend-llvm/src/link_cache.rs:key after tool(clang), before first clang -### probe; build.rs:932-1021 already handles None by original clang and omits post-key/capture.
priority_slice.policy: Use existing ELF GNU-build-ID presence only as economic admission hint. No-ID, unsupported, malformed or unreadable hint refuses optional cache and preserves ordinary command errors. No workload-tuned file-size threshold, persistent startup hash, new runtime flag, direct-ld execution or wrapper substitution.
priority_slice.authority: For admitted drivers retain unchanged full key: current driver/linker identities, full env, actual object and library/script bytes, dynamic dependencies/interpreter, scripts/search and negative directories, command options, pre/post fresh key equality. Build ID hint alone never authorizes reuse.
counterexamples: No-ID wrapper with different actual vs -### behavior still executes its actual command on every request; prior direct-ld proposal remains rejected.
Tiny no-ID driver may have cheap proof and lose beneficial reuse: conservative economic miss is intentional, not a universal speed claim.
Driver replacement between hint and proof must still face full current proof; missing hints cannot be cached as an authority.

Many PT_NOTE entries can make current parser expensive: per-note 1 MiB x up to 1024 headers is not a strict cheap total. Optional total note-read admission bound may refuse cache; never weaken installed identity fallback.
acceptance: Test actual no-ID refusal before all discovery and fallback hashing, followed by original configured clang invocation.

Retain existing complete final-link proof and invalidation tests. tests.rs:2130 and :2481 currently demand actual reuse on installed no-ID clang; keep this path tested using a scoped cfg(test)-only economic-admission override if necessary, without bypassing any proof or adding a production option.
GNU-ID admitted path still exercises complete pre/post proof; malformed/overbudget hints go to ordinary linking.
Run unified existing gates plus same complete cold/edit/ELF comparison after batched implementation; no claim of measured speedup before execution.

native_batch_slice.name: Prove already-correct mapped use sequence before allocating rank map
native_batch_slice.evidence: Prior code allocated std::map nodes and sorted for every cloned local value, including zero/one or already-ordered uses. Current concurrent patch adds complete lockstep mapped Use comparison with original rank/sort fallback.
native_batch_slice.proof: Map every source Use owner and operand index into current destination; verify mapped operand targets current mapped Value and equals next destination Use; both sequences must end together. Only exact equality skips sorting; mismatch runs unchanged full rank-map checks and sort. Keep all arguments, blocks, instructions, snapshot/replay call sites, verifyModule and use-order-preserving bitcode.
counterexamples: Reversed multi-use order needs fallback sort.
Extra/missing destination uses must not pass.
Unmapped owner, wrong operand or wrong value must reject.
Same printed IR does not prove equal use order.
